offering_description.value: Designs and manufactures performance inboard boats, including wakeboard and ski boats, sold to recreational consumers through independent dealers. The company also sells boat parts and accessories.

primary_products.value: wakeboard and ski boats; pontoon and deck boats; performance boats; boat parts and accessories

customer_segment.value: B2C: individual recreational boaters and watersports enthusiasts

revenue_model.value: product sales: boats sold to dealers and parts and accessories sold to dealers and consumers

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: builds boats from purchased engines, components and materials, sold to independent dealers; brand owner: designs and markets its boat brands and accessories to dealers and consumers

geography_served.value: global: US dealer network plus international dealers in Europe, Australia and Asia

specialization.value: related lines: wakeboard and ski boats, pontoon and deck boats, and boat parts and accessories sharing dealers and customers

distribution_channels.value: distributors / dealers: independent boat dealers in the US and abroad; online: online sales of parts and accessories

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: boat safety standards from the US Coast Guard and engine emissions rules from EPA and CARB

notes: Product lines and acquisitions may have changed since my knowledge was last updated.
